name: dumbbell-range
title: Dumbbell Range
description: Two endpoints per row joined by a connector on a shared zero-based scale — the dumbbell genre for paired values like min/max or input/output.

meta.question: How far apart are the two values per row, and who sits where?
meta.whenToUse: Comparing a two-point range across a handful of named entities where both endpoints and the gap matter (price min/max, input/output cost, before/after scores).
meta.antiUse: Not for more than 2 points per row (use a range strip or box plot) and not for time series — use lines.
